svg.title: Model mix by turns and by tokens
svg.desc: Haiku 81 percent of turns but 29 percent of tokens; Sonnet 14 percent of turns, 48 percent of tokens; Opus 5 percent of turns, 24 percent of tokens. 607 priced OS turns, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-04.

svg.text: Most turns are cheap — most tokens are real work
